programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: Martyna Wojciechowska reaches Thailand with a television crew.The heroine of the episode is 36-year-old Macieng, who, along with other refugees, was forced to leave Burma.Her neck is lengthened by a dozen brass hoops.This is a traditional way of decorating women of the Padaung people.There are various theories presenting the origins of this custom.One of them involves punishing women for infidelity.Macieng takes care of four children herself and earns her living by selling souvenirs to tourists.Western tourists pay several dollars to see the thick rings around her neck.

programs.title: Woman at the end of the world
programs.desc: The second edition of a series of reportages by Martyna Wojciechowska presenting the customs and life situation of women living in remote corners of the earth.

programs.title: Shocking dishes
programs.desc: Each country has its own traditional dishes.Unusual dishes include:baked bats or bee larvae in honey.Jarosław Nowak gets to know the strangest cuisines in the world.

programs.title: A journey into the unknown: Following the Yeti
programs.desc: Josh Gates sets out to find the yeti, the legendary half-man, half-ape that lives high in the Himalayas.During this expedition, the traveler talks to world-famous researchers.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: One German ship sunk, several damaged - this was the effect of the Polish fleet in September 1939.The losses are the result of an erroneous strategy of the staff of Commander Aleksander Mohuczy, commander of the submarine division.As a result, crews had to fight for their own survival instead of focusing on destroying enemy forces.The episode is devoted to the faulty tactical plan of the Polish Navy and the story of the only success of Polish ships during the September Campaign - the installation of minefields by ORP Żbik to protect the coast, on which the enemy minesweeper M-85 sank, losing 24 of the 51 crew members.For almost 74 years, the location of the wreck was unknown.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: A team of divers is combing the bottom of the Baltic Sea in search of sunken ships.Witnesses of the events, historians and documentarians discover their history and look for answers to troubling questions.
